decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
With appropriate safeguarding conditions, it is considered that this application for Advertisement Consent at 20 Church Street would not harm the appearance the buildings under construction or the character of the surrounding area, and would not harm the appearance of neighbouring residential and office buildings, the character of the Conservation Area or highway safety.  The proposal is considered to be in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development),  ENV-B 1.4 (Advertisements), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENV-B 2.5 (Development affecting the setting of a Listed Building), ENV-W 1.1 (Design in the Thames Policy Area) and T.4.4 (Road Safety) of the Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - This consent is granted for a limited period until the building works at 20 Church Street are substantially complete and no later than 1 September 2008, whichever is the earlier, after which date, the advertisements shall be removed.

Condition : 3 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 5 - Where any advertisement is required under these regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

Condition : 7 - No advertisment shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway ( including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).

Condition : 8 - The advertisement hoardings, hereby approved, shall not be erected until a sample of the colour to be used in the lettering of the advertisements, (not white and not reflective paint), hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Installation of non illuminated temporary advertisement hoarding to building
